description: An eight-step sequencer, one knob per step, advanced by an external clock.

params.text: Chooses what a high level at the EFFECT jack does: up runs the sequence backwards, middle holds it on its present step, down glides from one step's voltage to the next.

inputs.text: The clock that advances the sequencer, one step on each rising edge.
Applies whichever effect the switch has selected while this is high.

outputs.text: The voltage of the step the sequencer is on.
A ramp following the position through the eight steps.

notes: Set Rack's sample rate to 96kHz before using this module. At any other rate it runs at the wrong speed, and a red bar appears across the bottom of the panel saying so.
Nothing moves until a clock is patched into CLK; with the jack empty the sequencer holds on its first step.

inputs.0:
high above 2.5V · stepped · one channel only

a negative voltage does nothing here.
inputs.1:
high above 2.5V · stepped · one channel only

a negative voltage does nothing here.
